steps.title: What is Google Maps?
steps.body:
Google Maps is a digital map of the whole world. You can use it to look up addresses, plan routes, and see how busy a place is.

Open Google Maps through the app on your phone or via maps.google.com in your browser.

steps.title: Looking up an address
steps.body:
1. Click or tap the search bar at the top
  2. Type an address, place name, or business name
  3. Choose the right result from the list

A red pin now appears on the map at that location.

steps.title: Planning a route
steps.body:
Click the blue 'Directions' button. Fill in where you're leaving from and where you want to go. At the top, choose how you want to travel:

  • 🚗 Car
  • 🚲 Bicycle
  • 🚶 Walking
  • 🚌 Public transport

Google Maps now shows the route and travel time.

steps.title: Exercise
steps.body: Look up your own address below and plan a route to the nearest supermarket.

steps.title: Tip: Street View
steps.body: Drag the little yellow figure (bottom right of the map) onto a street to look around as if you were standing there yourself. Handy for recognizing an address before you go there!

steps.title: What is Marktplaats?
steps.body: Marktplaats is a website where people buy and sell second-hand items, from bicycles to furniture. Anyone can post something or buy something.

steps.title: Searching for something
steps.body:
1. Type what you're looking for in the search bar, for example 'ladies bicycle'
  2. Use the filters on the left to search by price or distance from your home
  3. Click a listing to view photos and the description

steps.title: Buying safely: watch out for scams
steps.body:
Most sellers are honest, but be careful:

  • Never pay in advance through a link sent to you in a message
  • Arrange to view the item in person and pay then, or use Marktplaats's own secure payment option
  • Not sure? Check with family first

steps.title: Selling something yourself
steps.body:
Click 'Place ad'. Add:

  • A few clear photos
  • A short, honest title and description
  • A price

steps.title: Exercise
steps.body: Browse Marktplaats below and search for something that interests you, without buying anything.

steps.title: What is Funda?
steps.body: Funda is the best-known Dutch website for browsing homes for sale or rent. Useful if you're moving yourself, or just curious about house prices in your area.

steps.title: Searching by location
steps.body:
1. Type a place name or postal code in the search bar
  2. Press Enter or select the place from the list
  3. You'll now see all the homes for sale there

steps.title: Using filters
steps.body:
Above the results you can filter by, for example:

  • Price (minimum and maximum)
  • Number of rooms
  • Property type (apartment, house, bungalow)

steps.title: Viewing a property
steps.body: Click a property to see photos, the floor plan, and all the details, such as surface area and year built.

steps.body: Search for properties in your own town below.

steps.title: What are NPO Start and YouTube?
steps.body: NPO Start is the app/website for catching up on Dutch TV shows. YouTube is a website full of videos on almost any topic, from recipes to documentaries.

steps.title: Searching for a show or video
steps.body:
1. Click the magnifying glass icon 🔍
  2. Type a show name or topic
  3. Click the video you want to watch

steps.title: Controls while watching
steps.body:
• Click the picture to pause or resume
  • Drag the bar at the bottom to skip forward or back
  • The speaker icon controls the volume
  • On YouTube: the 'CC' icon turns subtitles on or off

steps.title: Note: advertisements
steps.body: On YouTube, ads sometimes appear before or during a video. After a few seconds you can usually click 'Skip' in the bottom right. Close a pop-up asking for money or personal details with the X — never click on suspicious pop-ups.

steps.title: What is 9292?
steps.body: 9292 is the Dutch journey planner for public transport: bus, tram, metro, and train. You enter where you want to go and 9292 finds the best route for you.

steps.title: Entering departure and arrival points
steps.body:
1. Type your starting point under 'From' (for example your town or a station)
  2. Type your destination under 'To'
  3. Click 'Plan journey'

steps.title: Departure time and travel options
steps.body: You can choose 'Leave now' or set a different time. 9292 then shows several travel options with departure and arrival times, the number of transfers, and often the price too.

steps.title: What is Facebook?
steps.body: Facebook is a social network for sharing posts, photos, and news with friends and family. There are also groups: gathering places for people with the same interest or hometown.

steps.title: Finding a local group
steps.body:
1. Type something like 'Neighborhood group [your town]' in the search bar at the top
  2. Click 'Groups' in the results
  3. Open a group and click 'Join'

steps.title: Staying safe on Facebook
steps.body:
• Don't share your address, date of birth, or vacation plans publicly
  • Check who can see your posts under Settings > Privacy
  • Don't accept friend requests from people you don't know
